prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption (new_screen, redesign), home (new_flow), and choose_path (reorder) changes because only one test has been completed for each.
Evidence is still thin for finish (new_screen) changes because the two completed tests disagreed after noise correction (+7.7% vs -6.2%).
Reordering sign_in steps was helpful overall, backed by 4 positive noise-corrected tests including 1 win (+8.0%), though no clear effect was seen in the other 3 tests.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, but were too low for the round 8 sign_in reorder test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, reorder: -2.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -0.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -8.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.5% after noise correction, 4 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 82.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, new_flow] Background Pet Preparation Status Stream: Introduces a status stream screen after waiting that actively confirms rendering, trait setup, and file placement steps. (why: The waiting stage takes a long median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-offs when users think the app has frozen or stalled.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Late Sign-In Relocation Prior To Onboarding Completion: Moves sign_in screen after pet creation and adoption certificate steps, right before final desktop loading. (why: Earlier tests show sign_in step relocation post-adoption improves conversion (+8.0% noise-corrected win in earlier tests), letting users build affinity with their pet before committing an account.)
2: [adoption, incentive] Companion Adoption Completion Progress Incentive: Adds an official adoption status badge and step progress bar on the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (60.9%) and long completion times.)
3: [sign_in, notification] Account Sync Risk Prevention Banner: Displays a visible warning hint on sign_in instructing returning users to sign in with their original provider to prevent pet resets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in with a different account.)
4: [finish, hint] Desktop Visibility & Taskbar Quick Guidance Tip: Adds a explicit hint callout on home_intro explaining how to locate the pet icon in system tray or taskbar if it does not appear on top immediately. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets not showing on the desktop or failing to open immediately after onboarding completion.)
5: [choose_path, new_screen] App Mode Selection Screen: Inserts a high-level usage purpose screen prior to choose_path to differentiate between active companion mode and quiet widget mode. (why: Choose path drop-offs and long mean times suggest users need clarity upfront on how the app operates on desktop before selecting specific paths.)

scores.note: Home step has long wait times, but new_flow historically reduced conversion (-8.3%).
Reordering sign_in is backed by 4 positive tests including an 8.0% win.
Adoption step has the highest drop-off (39.1%); progress incentive targets the biggest bottleneck.
Both funnel and 8 support emails confirm account reset confusion on sign_in.
Low-cost hint addressing 3 support tickets regarding missing desktop icon.
Adding a new screen to choose_path risks introducing extra friction.
